title: Edit is one glyph across the corpus: ic-pencil, not ic-pen
notes: app-shell and redline now use ic-pencil for the Edit action on filmcards and layer rows, which is what icons.mjs maps 'edit' to; ic-pen is the bezier TOOL and must not double as the edit verb. 50 other pages plus shared/components/entry.js (its injected history cards) still emit <i class="ic ic-pen"> inside title="Edit" controls, so the corpus disagrees with its own exemplar. Mechanical sweep: replace 'title="Edit"><i class="ic ic-pen"' with ic-pencil across pages/ and entry.js, then re-run the browser audit-sweep and spot-check the icon in a filmcard action row.
